g.text: IoT Camp Test Bed — 6 Rooms, 3 SSIDs with PPSK (VLAN-per-Room)
- Single UniFi Express 7 provides routing, DHCP, VLANs, and Wi-Fi
- Only 3 SSIDs broadcast — within UX7 4-per-band hardware limit
- PPSK maps each room's passphrase to its dedicated VLAN
- No RADIUS server required — PPSK is native to UniFi
- Zigbee devices connect via USB coordinator (off Wi-Fi)
Allowed path: Home Assistant (Trusted) can reach same-room IoT devices
Blocked: IoT cannot initiate back to Trusted; cross-zone lateral blocked by firewall
Zigbee: Aqara sensors pair to ZBDongle-E via Zigbee mesh (off Wi-Fi)
